mesh_import.title: Import existing STEINEL Mesh
mesh_import.description: Paste the contents of the JSON exported by the STEINEL Connect app. Reset and provisioning are skipped, preserving groups, scenes and sensor settings. Only the selected node's credentials and bound models are stored. Close the app while Home Assistant connects over Bluetooth.

mesh_node.title: Select the exported device
mesh_node.description: Choose the node matching the Bluetooth address entered earlier. The phone's provisioner and excluded nodes are omitted.

mesh_credentials.title: Mesh sender and runtime state
mesh_credentials.description: Choose an existing bound AppKey. Reserve a separate unused unicast source for this HA entry in your network's address allocation; never use the phone's or a lamp's address. Enter the current IV Index (usually 0 for a new network); the export may omit it. Sequence 0 is valid only for a source never used before. When restoring a previously used source, enter its next unused sequence. Addresses are hexadecimal (e.g. 7FFE); IV Index and sequence are decimal.

reset_failed.title: Mesh reset failed for {name}
reset_failed.description: Close the STEINEL app and every other Bluetooth client completely. Briefly disconnect the lamp from mains power, restore power, and immediately start the repair. The reset is accepted only during a short startup window.

init.title: Retry Mesh reset
init.description: Completely close the STEINEL app and other Bluetooth clients. Switch {name} off at the mains, wait briefly, switch it on, then press Submit immediately. Home Assistant will retry reset and setup in the short startup window.
